_comment: Model recipe catalog for colab-llm-deploy. The orchestrator uploads this to /content/models.json; deploy_llm.py resolves config['model'] against it. vram_gb = steady-state estimate incl. context; min_vram_gb = hard tier gate.

deepseek-coder-6.7b-q4.notes: T4-ok. Code specialist; Ollama default quant is Q4_K_M.

phi4-14b-q4.notes: Needs >=24GB (L4/A10G tier), NOT a T4 recipe. Ollama library tag; default quant Q4_K_M. (No verified AWQ/FP8 Hub repo for Phi-4 was available, so this ships on Ollama rather than vLLM.)

qwen2.5-7b-awq.notes: T4-tight but workable (gpu-memory-utilization 0.90, ctx capped at 4096 on <30GB). A100-preferred for headroom. Pass hf_token in config for reliable Hub download.

qwen2.5-7b-q4.notes: Default T4 recipe. GGUF via Ollama library; OpenAI-compatible /v1.

qwen2.5-14b-q4.notes: Largest T4-ok recipe (~9GB GGUF Q4_K_M). Needs >=12GB VRAM.

qwen3.5-4b-q4.notes: T4-ok, light. Qwen3.5 4B, Ollama default quant (Q4_K_M).

qwen3.5-27b-q4.notes: Needs >=24GB (L4/A10G tier), NOT a T4 recipe.

gemma4-12b-q4.notes: T4-ok. Gemma 4 12B (Mar 2026, Apache 2.0), ~7GB Q4_K_M. Strong all-rounder.

gemma4-e4b-q4.notes: T4-ok, light. Gemma 4 E4B (8B/4.5B eff), ~5GB Q4_K_M.

gpt-oss-20b.notes: T4-tight. 20B MoE (~14GB MXFP4); most capable per-GB in class. Needs >=14GB VRAM.

mimo-v2.6-9b-q4.notes: T4-ok. Xiaomi MiMo V2.6 distill of Qwen 9B (~6GB Q4_K_M); Ollama pulls direct from HF via hf.co prefix.
